cards.back: Capabilities and biases come from the training mixture—inspect the data recipe before choosing a provider or checkpoint.
Under a fixed compute budget, balance model size and training tokens; many models were under-trained on tokens relative to parameters.
Turn raw pre-trained completion into steerable, usable chat behavior—also where many safety and format behaviors are baked in.
Randomness vs determinism in decoding—higher temperature → more diverse outputs; tune for your task’s need for consistency.
Labels come from the data itself (predict next token)—enables training on huge unlabeled corpora.
Models are probabilistic by construction—inconsistency needs eval, retrieval, and system design, not hope alone.
